# AHEAD

> Luxury Indian watch brand. Tagline: "Be Ahead Of Time". Designed for the ambitious — entrepreneurs, students, and self-improvement focused youth aged 18–28.

AHEAD blends Swiss-grade craftsmanship with bold, minimal, movement-driven Indian design. The brand is launching soon and currently accepting waitlist signups for early access and the limited Founder Drop (150 pieces).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand story, philosophy, product showcase, waitlist signup, founder drop countdown, testimonials.
